source.title: Skatteverket: Belopp och procent – inkomstår 2026 (Skiktgräns; Statlig inkomstskatt, fysiska personer; Brytpunkt)

sections.basis: Taxable earned income (beskattningsbar förvärvsinkomst), per year
sections.note: Municipal income tax (on average 32.38%) is due on all taxable earned income; state tax comes on top above the threshold. With the basic allowance the state tax starts at an income of SEK 660,400 (under 66) or SEK 760,500 (66 or older at the start of the year).

sections.title: Earned-income tax credit (jobbskatteavdrag) 2026

rows.label: Under 66: work income up to SEK 53,872
rows.value: (work income − basic allowance) × municipal tax rate

rows.label: Under 66: work income above SEK 53,872 up to SEK 191,808
rows.value: (0.91 PBB (SEK 53,872) + 38.74% of the work income above 0.91 PBB − basic allowance) × municipal tax rate

rows.label: Under 66: work income above SEK 191,808 up to SEK 478,336
rows.value: (1.813 PBB (SEK 107,329.60) + 25.10% of the work income above 3.24 PBB (SEK 191,808) − basic allowance) × municipal tax rate

rows.label: Under 66: work income above SEK 478,336
rows.value: (3.027 PBB (SEK 179,198.40) − basic allowance) × municipal tax rate

rows.label: 66 or older: work income up to SEK 103,600
rows.value: 22% of the work income

rows.label: 66 or older: work income above SEK 103,600 up to SEK 310,208
rows.value: 0.2635 PBB (SEK 15,599.20) plus 7% of the work income
